ownership.quote: TinyFish provides enterprise infrastructure for AI web agents. Run hundreds of websites simultaneously to navigate, authenticate, extract data, and automate web workflows with a fully serverless architecture.

stage.quote: The Series A round was led by ICONIQ Capital, with U.S. Venture Partners LP, Mango Capital, MongoDB Ventures, Alpine Software Group and Sandberg Bernthal Venture Partners also participating.
stage.note: TinyFish itself has not gone through an accelerator; it separately hosts 'The TinyFish Accelerator' (funded by Mango Capital) for OTHER early-stage startups — that $2M seed pool is not TinyFish's own funding and is excluded here.

total_funding_usd.basis: Only one priced institutional round reported (Series A); Tracxn independently lists total funding as $47M over 1 round.
total_funding_usd.quote: Enterprise web agent infrastructure startup TinyFish Inc. revealed today that it has raised $47 million in new funding to expand product development and go-to-market efforts.

last_round.quote: The Series A round was led by ICONIQ Capital, with U.S. Venture Partners LP, Mango Capital, MongoDB Ventures, Alpine Software Group and Sandberg Bernthal Venture Partners also participating.

employees.source: search snippets (unverified aggregator commentary) describe the team as 'relatively small (under 50 employees)'; not independently confirmed

note: Founded 2024 in Palo Alto, CA by Sudheesh Nair (former Nutanix/ThoughtSpot exec), Shuhao Zhang, and Keith Zhai. Raised $47M Series A led by ICONIQ Capital (announced 2025-08-20), with USVP, Mango Capital, MongoDB Ventures, Alpine Software Group and Sandberg Bernthal Venture Partners participating. TinyFish separately runs its own startup accelerator ('The TinyFish Accelerator', financed by Mango Capital with a $2M seed pool) for third-party founders — not to be confused with TinyFish's own funding history.
